children: Quanome Technologies, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $5.85M, up from $2.76M a year earlier, while the company posted a net loss attributable to the company of $(9.48M) and a basic and diluted loss per share of $(0.36) for the year.
Revenue was $5.85M, compared with $2.76M in the prior year; YoY change 111.8%.
Net income was $(9.48M), compared with $(5.25M) in the prior year; YoY change (80.6%).
Diluted EPS was $(0.36), compared with $(0.69) in the prior year; YoY change 48%.
Revenue from pharmaceutical distribution rose about 112% year over year to $5.85M, driven by higher infusion-product sales and a larger active customer base.
Infusion products made up roughly 91% of pharmaceutical revenue in 2026, indicating strong concentration in that product category.
In February 2026 the company disposed of its U.S. cross-border logistics business (ABL Chicago) and refocused operations solely on China pharmaceutical distribution.
In September 2026 Quanome launched AI compute/inference services through its subsidiary XDT Infrastructure I to diversify its operations.
Management highlighted liquidity dependence on a large third-party loan receivable, noting collections are critical to fund ongoing pharmaceutical operations.
